integrity: Explicit ballot-generation algorithm and exact majority margins; analytic resolvent and stationary-distribution derivation; reproducible standard-library rational checker. No independent validation or exhaustive priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Worst-case five-alternative counterexamples with unbounded finite electorates; neither minimal voter count nor minimal candidate count nor typical-election incidence is determined. Proof is analytic with exact-rational checks. Historical priority outside inspected sources remains uncertain.
title: Fixed damping never uniformly preserves a Condorcet winner in five-alternative BallotRank
